acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Giants family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Brute, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Falling-Timber Sweeper (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Twice human height with bare weathered skin, rough hide clothing, dense limbs, a slight stoop, and a stripped tree-trunk club with no developed body geology.

Signature mechanic: Timber Fall: the Brute grips its tree trunk at one end and drops the full length across a marked lane; the club remains grounded until the Giant walks its hands down and lifts again, creating cover on one side and an exposed hand on the other.
battlefieldDuty: Clear a broad but slow front with a tree-trunk club, leaving the fallen timber as a temporary obstacle that changes one simple route through the arena.
constructionDimensions: Anatomy and materials stay naturally weathered: thick skin, rough hide, ordinary raw stone plates, moss, lichen, pines, rope, and iron chain accumulate through age and scale rather than magical replacement.
Motion and wake remain physical and local: muscle loading, chain drag, loose scree, falling needles, water runoff, and impact dust reveal mass without persistent elemental trails or luminous anatomy.
counterplay: Cross behind the planted heel before the trunk falls, then strike the grounded hand or use the fallen timber to block the Brute's shortest turn. Affinity signal: Hands, heels, rope knots, chain pivots, rune anchors, unstable shelves, and ordinary fracture seams remain visible at every scale as the form's established weak points.
forbiddenTreatments: Landscape coverage that obscures the Giant's humanoid joints and committed weight shifts
identityInvariants: Humanlike proportions scaled upward with a heavy brow, thick limbs, dense bone, and a slight stoop that communicates the body's own weight.
Stone grey, granite blue-grey, earth brown, moss green, glacier white, and warm amber eyes remain the family palette without requiring an elemental origin.
Rough hide, raw stone, moss, lichen, pine, iron chain, and rope accumulate as bodily geology and oversized practical tools.
Chains, standing-stone jewelry, skin runes, and whole trees function as ornament at a scale that stays legible from the arena.
Raw scale and geological coverage escalate together until the Sovereign carries a valley, but every form retains recognizable humanoid load paths and slow committed motion.
telegraph: Its weathered hands slide to the trunk's far end, the rear heel digs a dark crescent in the soil, and the bare shoulder rises beneath the weight.
